title: Close reconciliation + exception register
description: Extract balances from both systems, merge them declaratively, and drive everything that would not reconcile into a source-tagged exception register.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-acct-01
  title: Close reconciliation + exception register
  description: Extract balances from both systems, merge them declaratively, and drive everything that
    would not reconcile into a source-tagged exception register.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Close the period with every reconciling difference itemized, aged, and attributed, and no
    difference netted away to make a balance agree.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Period-end balances and supporting detail
      summary: Period-end balances and supporting detail
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - ledger_balances
              - subledger_detail
              - bank_statements
              - period_end
            properties:
              ledger_balances: {}
              subledger_detail: {}
              bank_statements: {}
              period_end: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-source1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: acct-01
      name: Ledger-side classification and balances
      summary: 'Source extraction 1: ledger-side classification and balances.'
      role: Bookkeeper classifying transactions to the chart of accounts with an evidenced basis.
      prompt: You are a Transaction Classification Analyst. You classify each transaction to the chart
        of accounts with the supporting document and the policy basis named, and you flag anything whose
        classification depends on an assumption rather than evidence. You never force an ambiguous transaction
        into a familiar account to clear a queue — an unexplained suspense item is honest, a confidently
        wrong classification is not.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - finance-analysis
          - communication
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-source2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: acct-02
      name: Subledger and bank-side detail
      summary: 'Source extraction 2: subledger and bank-side detail.'
      role: Reconciliation specialist tying subledgers, banks, and intercompany balances to the ledger.
      prompt: You are a Reconciliation Analyst. You tie balances between systems, itemize every reconciling
        difference with its cause and age, and distinguish a timing difference from an error rather than
        netting them into one acceptable variance. You escalate aged unexplained differences instead of
        carrying them forward, because a reconciliation that only proves both sides move together proves
        nothing.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-union
      kind: transform
      name: Merge ledger and source-system records
      summary: merge the two extracted balance records on account, entity, and period
      config:
        operation: merge
        expression: merge the two extracted balance records on account, entity, and period
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: acct-02
      name: Reconcile matched balances
      summary: Reconcile fields that arrived from more than one source.
      role: Reconciliation specialist tying subledgers, banks, and intercompany balances to the ledger.
      prompt: You are a Reconciliation Analyst. You tie balances between systems, itemize every reconciling
        difference with its cause and age, and distinguish a timing difference from an error rather than
        netting them into one acceptable variance. You escalate aged unexplained differences instead of
        carrying them forward, because a reconciliation that only proves both sides move together proves
        nothing.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-exceptions
      kind: agent
      templateRef: acct-05
      name: State every unreconciled difference
      summary: Everything that could not be reconciled, stated as an exception.
      role: Independent reviewer testing whether the evidence supports the conclusion.
      prompt: You are an Audit Evidence Reviewer. You test whether the workpaper's conclusion follows
        from the evidence actually attached, checking sufficiency, appropriateness, and independence of
        the source, and you review without reading the preparer's conclusion first where the process allows.
        You state 'not supported' plainly rather than requesting clarifying language, because rewording
        an unsupported conclusion is how findings disappear.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-register
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect the exception register
      summary: Every unreconciled field is source-tagged so an exception keeps its provenance.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-clean
      kind: condition
      name: Exception register empty?
      summary: Route on register.exceptions is empty.
      config:
        expression: register.exceptions is empty
        branches:
          - label: Clean
            when: clean
          - label: Exceptions
            when: exceptions
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Controller sign-off on the close package
      summary: Pause for the controller; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Close reconciliation + exception register deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-source1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-source2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-3
      from: n-source1
      to: n-union
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-4
      from: n-source2
      to: n-union
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-5
      from: n-union
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-6
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-exceptions
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-7
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-register
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-8
      from: n-exceptions
      to: n-register
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-9
      from: n-register
      to: n-clean
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-10
      from: n-clean
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: clean
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-11
      from: n-clean
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: exceptions
    - id: wf-acct-01-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
